notes: APIOps Cycles / Osaango Ltd. Method content CC-BY-SA 4.0. Original artwork retained from the supplied Pariisi-Messuvihko.pptx. A points to Capability Strategy (api-product-strategy), B to Consumer & Producer Commitments (api-consumer-experience), C to the supporting governance station Roles and Responsibilities. Letter annotations identify the three questions, not a mandatory sequence. Start with the question where the team lacks agreement.
